description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the SegmentCloth operation in the image segmentation (imageseg) category
description_zh: 本文介绍分割抠图（imageseg）类目下的服饰分割SegmentCloth的语法及示例
name: SegmentCloth

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The type of the returned segmentation result. This parameter affects the returned content of the ImageURL field and is optional. Valid values:

0 (default): The default main clothing segmentation result.

1: The combined segmentation result of the user-specified classes
parameters.help_zh:
返回分割结果的类型，影响ImageURL字段的返回内容，用户非必选。

0（默认值）：默认的主体服饰分割结果。

1：用户指定class类别的组合分割结果
parameters.name: out_mode

parameters.help_en:
The clothing category. Valid values:
tops: Tops
coat: Coats
skirt: Skirts
pants: Pants
bag: Bags
shoes: Shoes
hat: Hats
parameters.help_zh:
服饰类别，取值范围：
tops：上衣
coat：外套
skirt：裙装
pants：裤装
bag：包类
shoes：鞋子
hat：帽子
parameters.name: cloth_class

parameters.help_en:
The format of the returned image. Valid values:

whiteBK: Returns an image with a white background.
mask: Returns a single-channel mask.
If you do not specify this parameter, a four-channel PNG image is returned.
This parameter applies only to the ImageURL field in the output result. It does not apply to the ClassUrl field, which always returns a mask channel image
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回的图像格式，取值范围：

whiteBK：返回白底图。
mask：返回单通道mask。
如果不设置，则返回四通道PNG图。
该参数的设置只对输出结果的ImageURL有效，对ClassUrl无效，ClassUrl固定返回的是mask通道图
parameters.name: return_form

additionalProperties.description_en:
The URL corresponding to a clothing category based on the `clothClass` parameter specified by the user.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. If you need to store the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
additionalProperties.description_zh:
根据用户输入的`clothClass`返回一个服饰类别对应的URL。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the matting result image.
The returned image is a four-channel PNG image without compression. The image size remains unchanged, but the file size increases.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. If you need to store the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
返回抠图结果图像URL地址。
抠图之后返回四通道PNG图，无压缩，图像尺寸保持不变，图像体积会变大。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
